features_list.body: We never build spyware. Your data stays yours—we prioritize local solutions that work offline whenever possible.
Never selling marketing. We build apps that solve real problems, not flashy gimmicks.
Our business model isn't built on selling people's data for profit. We believe in selling real value and earning your trust.

site_notes.note: Made with ❤️ by the Aqhwan team. Open source at aqhwan/website

header.title: About Aqhwan
header.body: Aqhwan is a small, passionate team dedicated to creating useful, high-quality apps with a laser focus on privacy and user respect. We believe technology should empower you, not exploit you.

sections.title: Get in Touch
sections.body: Have a question or an idea? Drop us an email at contact@aqhwan.app. For development discussions and community chat, join our Discord server. You'll find all our links below!

sections.title: Meet the Team
sections.body: We're a small group of developers and designers who care deeply about digital rights. We were tired of apps that treat users like products.

sections.title: Common Questions
sections.body: Wondering how we make money? We keep it simple: we build great software and charge fairly for it (or offer free versions with heart). No hidden fees, no data harvesting. Curious about our roadmap? Check out our public GitHub repo or ask us!

sections.title: Your Privacy Matters
sections.body: We take your data seriously. That's why we use end-to-end encryption where possible, store minimal data, and never irresponsibly share your information with third parties for profit, advertising purposes, or exploitation in general. Our privacy policy is written in plain English, not legalese. Read it on https://aqhwan.app/privacy to see exactly how we protect you.
